Game Overview

Retro Sprunki is a casual title where embark on a whimsical adventure with Sprunki in a vibrant pixelated realm. Navigate atmospheric landscapes, leaping over rolling stones while collecting radiant jewels. With simple controls and increasingly challenging terrain, Retro Sprunki offers an addictive blend of endless runner excitement and nostalgic charm. How high can you score?
